name: README Generator
summary: Scaffold a project README.md from title, features, install, and more — locally in your browser.
description: Fill in project details, toggle sections, optionally paste badge markdown, and copy a clean README.md. Ideal for new repos and template docs. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Can I include badges?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paste badge markdown into the badges field, or generate them with the Readme Badges Generator and paste the result.

faqs.question: Do I have to keep every section?
faqs.answer: No. Toggle sections on or off; empty fields are also skipped.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
